OAT-03/S15.title: Step 5: tap Generate, then reload, leave, lock the phone or background the app for 30 s and return — the note, a 'generating' state, or an explicit failure, never blank
OAT-03/S15.detail: PW, local stack, web cells (generateNote mocked at the socket, answered 8 s after it is asked). Hospital: Generate, reload at once (the request in flight), 30 s, Post-Round: FAILED — only 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' with the spinning 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' button (B27): no note, no generating state, no failure; the dictation is kept (passed). Nursing Home: Generate, the chart's back arrow at once (no reload), 30 s on the list, reopen, Post-Round: passed (the page that started the call was still alive and saved the note). Judged U4 (TFA-92592 AC 15): failed on the reload cell. Phone cells (lock an iPhone 30 s, background the Android app 30 s) are device-only: not run (an emulator run on e02167f, dvc OAT-03/S20, kept the note after 30 s in the background with a scripted 25 s model wait). On 43c38a4f the note is still generated by the page: the browser calls ai/notes:generateNote, gets the text back and saves it with its own mutation (useNoteGeneration.ts finalize, snf EncounterTab.tsx handleGenerate); 'feat: use jobs for generation' (68f81eca) moved only the billing suggestion to a server job (no scheduler use for notes anywhere in convex/). Every Generate used a 'procedure-other' custom note template because on 43c38a4f saving a generated note queues a server billing job (billing/persistence.ts enqueueBilling → ai/billing.ts run) that no socket mock can answer and that would reach Bedrock on this stack; the template only changes the (mocked) model's instruction text. Tripwire: no model call at all during the run.
OAT-03/S15.productIssue: Reloading (or the app being killed) right after Generate leaves Post-Round blank apart from 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' and a spinner that never stops; the note is gone and nothing says so.
